## Context
The generated configuration reference contains an unsupported MCP exposure claim and lacks public descriptions for emitted settings. Hand-authored configuration guidance also contains stale ADR references and diagnostic-switch state. `consensual-ignored-ivorygull` records the accepted generator design. ADR 0086 and ADR 0087 provide current decision references.

## Plan
- Complete three bounded child tasks for generator narrative, setting descriptions, and current-state guidance.
- Preserve generator ownership of `docs/config-reference.md`.
- Keep each child behavior-neutral.
- Do not create an MCP configuration tool.
- Do not decide the deferred F05 generated-artifact catalog.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] F19A removes the nonexistent MCP configuration-surface claim through the generator.
- [x] F19B provides one generated public description for every emitted typed setting.
- [x] F19C corrects ADR references and diagnostic-switch guidance.
- [x] Generated files remain source-owned and drift checked.
- [x] All children pass applicable targeted checks and land independently.
